# WaveWarZ Intelligence

> Verifiable onchain analytics for WaveWarZ — the decentralized music battle platform on Solana.
> Artists go head-to-head in timed battles while fans trade ephemeral tokens on the outcome.
> Every trade is denominated in SOL. Artists earn 1% of trading volume automatically; traders
> withdraw winnings manually after settlement. All data is sourced from the Solana blockchain
> (Program ID: 9TUfEHvk5fN5vogtQyrefgNqzKy2Bqb4nWVhSFUg2fYo, Solana Mainnet).

Main platform (trading): https://wavewarz.com
Analytics (this site): https://wavewarz.info
Unclaimed winnings recovery: https://claim.wavewarz.info
X / Twitter: https://x.com/wavewarz

## Public API (free, no auth)

- https://wavewarz.info/api/public/stats — platform totals: volume, claims, artist payouts, battle counts
- https://wavewarz.info/api/public/battles — battle list with pools, volume, winners
- https://wavewarz.info/api/public/events — upcoming events and tournaments
- https://wavewarz.info/api/public/leaderboards/artists — artist rankings
- https://wavewarz.info/api/public/leaderboards/songs — quick-battle song rankings
- https://wavewarz.info/api/public/leaderboards/traders — trader rankings
- Docs: https://wavewarz.info/api-docs

## Key concepts

- Battle types: Main Events (artist vs artist), Quick Battles (song vs song, Audius-powered,
  ~6-9 min), Community Battles (anything vs anything).
- Quick Battle winner = 2 of 3 factors: live poll, trading charts, DJ Wavy (AI judge).
- Fees: 1.5% per trade total (1.0% to the artist, 0.5% platform). Settlement splits the losing
  pool 50% losing traders / 40% winning traders / 5% winning artist / 2% losing artist / 3% platform.
- Battle duration is variable — always computed from onchain start/end timestamps.
